note: North-shore (Horsethief) area of Kanopolis SP on the 3,500-acre reservoir in the Smoky Hills: the Eagle Point water-and-electric loop on the shore bluff, the Rockin' K equestrian campground, primitive shoreline camping (Eagle Point North/South, Sandyshore, Buzzard Bay, Rockwall) and the Horsethief Canyon trailheads. Reservable online Apr 1-Sep 30; FCFS Oct-Mar (KDWP). --Claude
